boundary.description: From the junction of Turton Road and Shady Lane, E along Turton Road, Printers Lane to the end of the road, then by a beeline to and S along Broadshaw Brook to and W along Thicketford Road, S Crompton Way, Abingdon Road (both sides in St Columba parish), Ainsworth Lane, Entwistle Street and by a beeline to and N along River Tonge, Eagley Brook and by a footpath to Darwen Road and Turton Road to its junction with Shady Lane.
